tagline: WZFO取景器相机，1965 年发布
description: WZFO于1965年推出的取景器相机。配备fixed, meniscus, 75 mm 1:8。快门速度two leaf everset shutter, one 1/50 s shutter speed。使用manual, with red window。fix focus, from 2 m to infinity。

specs.对焦: fix focus, from 2 m to infinity
specs.快门: two leaf everset shutter, one 1/50 s shutter speed
specs.英文简介: The Ami is a toy viewfinder camera made of plastic by the Polish firm Warszawskie Zakłady Fotooptyczne (WZFO).
